justzoom.options.zoom_keybind.desc: The key or mouse button used to zoom.
justzoom.options.zoom_in_keybind.desc: The key, mouse button, or mouse wheel direction used to increase magnification while zooming.
justzoom.options.zoom_out_keybind.desc: The key, mouse button, or mouse wheel direction used to decrease magnification while zooming.
justzoom.options.open_options_keybind.de: The key or mouse button used to open Just Zoom's options screen.
justzoom.open_settings_toast: Press %s to open the zoom options.
justzoom.options.keybind.duplicate_desc:
This key is also used for:
%s
justzoom.options.base_zoom_factor.desc:
Sets the zoom level used when zooming starts.
0% starts without zooming; 100% starts at full zoom unless limited by Maximum Zoom.
Move the slider to preview the starting zoom live in the world.
justzoom.options.zoom_step_size.desc:
Controls the strength of each Zoom In or Zoom Out input.
100% is the normal step size.
50% is half as strong; 200% is as strong as two normal steps.
justzoom.options.smooth_zoom_in_out.desc: If the FOV should change smoothly when zooming in/out.
justzoom.options.start_zooming_animation:
The time, in seconds, the animation takes when starting to zoom.
0.00 seconds makes the animation instant.
Only applies when Smooth Zooming is enabled; otherwise zooming starts instantly.
justzoom.options.stop_zooming_animation_:
The time, in seconds, the animation takes when stopping zoom.
0.00 seconds makes the animation instant.
Only applies when Smooth Zooming is enabled; otherwise zooming stops instantly.
justzoom.options.smooth_zoom_scroll_spee:
Controls how quickly smooth zooming reacts to mouse-wheel zoom adjustments.
100% is the normal speed.
50% is half as fast; 200% is twice as fast.
justzoom.options.maximum_zoom_factor.des:
Limits how far Just Zoom can zoom in.
0% prevents zoom completely; 100% allows the full range.
Move the slider to preview the limit live in the world.
justzoom.options.smooth_camera_movement_: If the camera should move smoothly (cinematic) when zooming.
justzoom.options.normalize_mouse_sensiti:
If the mouse sensitivity should adjust itself to the zoomed view,
so it feels normal and not too fast when moving the mouse while zooming.
justzoom.options.improve_third_person_zo: If enabled, zooming in rear third-person view uses the first-person camera so the player does not block the zoomed view.
If enabled, the player's hand will be invisible while zooming.
justzoom.options.show_hud.desc: Controls when the HUD is visible while zooming.
justzoom.options.reset_zoom_factor_when_:
If enabled, zoom resets to Base Zoom when you stop zooming,
instead of remembering the last zoom level.
justzoom.options.use_just_zoom_for_spygl: If enabled, using a spyglass activates the same zoom mode as the normal zoom keybind.
justzoom.options.spyglass_overlay.desc: Controls when the spyglass overlay and its black border are shown.
justzoom.options.spyglass_sounds.desc: Controls when the spyglass sounds are played.
